classificationDefinitions.ENFORCED: an executable artefact proves it (test, verifier script, migration, policy or machine-checked contract match) and, where a boundary is declared, a real call site invokes it
classificationDefinitions.DECLARED: a module, document or contract mentions it, but nothing executable proves it
classificationDefinitions.IMPLEMENTED_UNWIRED: implementation and tests exist, but the declared boundary patterns match nothing — the capability protects nothing yet

areas.area: Runtime webhook delivery is signed, replay-resistant and retry bounded
areas.requirement: Webhook signatures, versions, timestamp skew, delivery attempts, retries and dead-letter outcomes are explicit.

areas.area: Runtime integration adapters preserve tenant context and canonical boundaries
areas.requirement: Adapters require tenant context when declared and external/canonical transformations remain explicit anti-corruption mappings.

areas.area: Runtime resilience uses circuit breakers, limits, timeouts and bulkheads
areas.requirement: Failures open circuits, rate limits reset and reject excess traffic, timeouts are capped, and bulkheads bound concurrency.

areas.area: Runtime features, approvals and bulk operations remain governed
areas.requirement: Feature flags honor tenant overrides and kill switches, approval requests expire and cannot be double-approved, and bulk operations track partial failures/transfers.

areas.area: Runtime capabilities and health signals are scoped and observable
areas.requirement: Capabilities enforce tenant/platform isolation and deprecation, logs redact sensitive fields, metrics expose percentiles, and health reflects degradation/unhealthy dependencies.

areas.area: Runtime installation, suspension, quotas and health operate at a live boundary
areas.requirement: Domain runtime manifests install/suspend/retire without kernel rewrites, with durable isolation, policy, quota and health evidence.

limitations: Classification measures the presence of executable evidence, not the correctness or completeness of that evidence.
A DECLARED area is unfinished work, never a false claim — it is reported as such.
An IMPLEMENTED_UNWIRED area has a tested implementation that no boundary calls; it is reported, never counted as enforcement.
Evidence patterns are declared per phase in architecture/phase-acceptance/phase-<id>-*.json and must be reviewed when a phase is re-audited.
